name: The Secret: Reloaded
source: Moving means troubles, worries and lots of wasted money and nerves. But not with my Mary. When my father passed away, Mary got control of the business. I don’t really know what she does… The only thing I know is that we have a lot of money and right now we are flying on the private plane to our new quarters.
translation: 搬家意味著麻煩、擔憂，還有大把白白耗掉的金錢與精力。但有我的瑪麗在，一切就不同了。父親去世後，瑪麗接管了生意。我其實不太清楚她在做什麼……只知道我們有很多錢，而且此刻，正坐著私人飛機前往新住處。
